cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You get to interpret it. I'd like to know whether membership reaches as far as your signature.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the same words have to cover me and their disapproval. Whose comfort does 'possible' protect?

mechanism: A organizes an allotment appeal and reduces signing work while testing whether where possible still includes backing A against other members pressure.
confusable: Unlike merely asking a favor, A makes applying the ambiguous club promise the measure of solidarity.
comparison: Public signature under club pressure differs from protecting a late family member meal.
seedUse: D179-b where possible, appeal and opposing members; S02-b handles paperwork and offers to speak to objectors.
